_comment: Copy into the project root as .uiverify.json. The file's presence switches the Stop hook on: a turn will not close while the check is red.
_checkPaths: Scope of the text-level bans. In a monorepo the new frontend sits next to legacy code with hundreds of violations; a gate over the whole tree would be red always. Field absent — the whole tree is checked.
_browserFloor: The oldest engines real visitors use — take it from your traffic logs, not from the bundler default. check-forbidden.sh and check-browser-floor.mjs read it; the gate runs the floor check only when a floor is declared here or in a browserslist.
_networkPaths: Where the one network layer lives. A raw fetch( anywhere else is flagged.
_minFontPx: Smallest allowed text size. 16 by default; a dense working tool records its exception here (for example 12), and the reason in the project notes.
_paletteClasses: Tailwind default palette classes (bg-blue-500) in components: "flag" (default) or "block" once the project has role tokens.
_scenarios: Modules that drive the app into the state worth checking (login, data, open dialogs). The contract is documented at the top of scripts/lib/session.mjs. Keep heavy scenarios out of the gate: it must answer in seconds.
_gateScenario: The Stop hook runs the browser check only with this scenario: the working screen, one breakpoint, answering in seconds. Without it the hook checks the source only — on an entry screen the browser part produced nothing but noise.
_fontScale: Root font size multiplier for one extra verify-ui pass: 1.25 catches layouts that break with large system text.
overlapSelector: h1, h2, h3, h4, p, li, button, a, label, span[class], td, th
_ignoreOverlap: Deliberate overlaps: display type over text, collages. A selector plus a comment saying why it is intended.
_ignoreDiff: Masks for visual regression: live data (clocks, counters, avatars) is painted over before the shot, otherwise "the clock ticked" reads as breakage.
_profile: Performance budgets: product (a working tool) or landing (a promo page).
_lexicon: Internal terms that must not appear in visible text. When set, they replace the built-in defaults, so any interface language works.
_consistency: verify-consistency.mjs: the same things must be the same on every page and in every row.
